facts.fact: The Centre for Information Technology and Development (CITAD) launched the PAWSOM-Monitor project on 2026-08-08 to track data-privacy violations and platform restrictions during elections, piloted at the Osun governorship election on 15 August 2026.
CITAD's executive director said CITAD researched Facebook pages bearing the names of politicians about four years earlier, finding for example 126 pages for Ganduje.
facts.system: CITAD study of politicians' Facebook pages
